Northland primarily serves individual truck and SUV owners in Montana and surrounding areas, as well as commercial fleets needing upfit solutions.

Customers include recreational off-road enthusiasts seeking suspension lifts and lighting from brands like Rigid Industries and Baja Designs, contractors requiring fiberglass or work-style truck toppers, and drivers needing animal-strike protection with full front bumpers and grille guards from Ranch Hand and Go Rhino.
